title: Held-out evaluator configuration
description: Everything application-specific the held-out evaluator needs. One profile per application; bind a story to a profile with evaluations/<KEY>/evaluation.json.

defaultAut.description: Profile used when a story has no evaluation.json binding.

apiBaseURL.description: API origin for the api fixture and api-probe. Defaults to baseURL.

blockHosts.description: Third-party hosts (ads, analytics, consent) whose requests the browser aborts, e.g. ["googlesyndication.com", "doubleclick.net"]. They are not part of the application and make pages flaky

minTestIntervalMs.description: Minimum gap between test starts in ms, across workers and worker restarts: for hosts that ban bursts of traffic (e.g. 12000)

accounts.description: How to make a test account on this AUT (mechanics, found while hardening the first story). Used by seed.account() (create, token, delete after the test) and signIn(page, account). Strings may use ${username}, ${password}, ${id}, ${token}, ${env:NAME}. `heldout doctor` runs it live.

password.description: Password of every test account, normally "${env:NAME}"

username.description: User-name template; ${uid} is unique per account. Default "qa-${uid}"

id.description: Dotted path of the new account's id in the response body, e.g. "userID"

token.description: Dotted path of the token in the response body

done.description: "url:/profile" or a page-locator expression that appears once signed in

maxWorkers.description: Most parallel test workers the host tolerates: set it for shared sandboxes behind rate limits or bot protection (e.g. 1). Caps --workers

testIdAttribute.description: Attribute used by getByTestId(): data-testid, data-test, data-qa…

healthcheck.description: Checked before every run. UI paths resolve against baseURL, "api:/path" against apiBaseURL.

healthSlowMs.description: Slowest healthcheck sample above this (ms) = degraded AUT; the run is refused.

mode.description: mock = file-backed Jira in ./mock-jira; cloud = Jira Cloud REST v3 (JIRA_EMAIL / JIRA_API_TOKEN in .env).

acceptanceCriteriaField.description: Custom field holding acceptance criteria, if your Jira uses one. Find it with: heldout doctor --jira
